title: Dermaself brings AI skin analysis into grocery retail: Italy’s biggest beauty counter now has its own AI Beauty Agent
summary: Dermaself and Coop Alleanza 3.0, the Italian cooperative operating in large-scale retail, bring an AI skin analysis smart mirror to the parapharmacy area of Ipercoop Baragalla in Reggio Emilia. Shoppers take a selfie and receive a skincare routine built from the products on the store’s own shelves
